Package primitives

Class VectorTests

java.lang.Object
primitives.VectorTests
class VectorTests extends Object
Unit tests for the Vector class.

This class contains a series of tests for the methods implemented in the Vector class, ensuring that the vector operations behave as expected. The tests include operations such as addition, length calculation, normalization, dot product, cross product, and scaling.

  • Method Details

    • testAdd

      @Test void testAdd()
      Test method for Vector.add(Vector).

      Verifies that the add() method correctly computes the sum of two vectors. Also checks that an exception is thrown when adding a zero vector.

    • testLengthSquared

      @Test void testLengthSquared()
      Test method for Vector.lengthSquared().

      Verifies that the lengthSquared() method correctly computes the squared length of a vector.

    • testLength

      @Test void testLength()
      Test method for Vector.length().

      Verifies that the length() method correctly computes the length of a vector.

    • testNormalize

      @Test void testNormalize()
      Test method for Vector.normalize().

      Verifies that the normalize() method correctly normalizes a vector, making it a unit vector.

    • testDotProduct

      @Test void testDotProduct()
      Test method for Vector.dotProduct(Vector).

      Verifies that the dotProduct() method correctly computes the dot product of two vectors.

    • testCrossProduct

      @Test void testCrossProduct()
      Test method for Vector.crossProduct(Vector).

      Verifies that the crossProduct() method correctly computes the cross product of two vectors. It also checks that an exception is thrown when the vectors are parallel.

    • testScale

      @Test void testScale()
      Test method for Vector.scale(double).

      Verifies that the scale() method correctly scales a vector by a scalar value. It also checks that an exception is thrown when scaling by zero.
